(AI Generated).

## Freed v26.9.1700-dev

Clearer Saved filters, incremental device sync, and more reliable Library recovery

### Features

- Freed Desktop can join an existing Library as a consumer device
- Desktop and PWA devices can catch up through incremental operations
- Joined devices report synchronization progress

### Fixes

- Saved titles now name active filters, such as Saved Inspiring and News, and return to Saved when Everything is selected
- Saved bookmarks remain visible after browsing Friends without inheriting the Friends-only view
- Desktop and PWA retain pending edits while refreshing Library checkpoints
- Desktop retains sync ownership until canceled work has settled
- PWA setup and Drive synchronization recover more reliably from interrupted transfers and device enrollment conflicts
- Drive credentials refresh during long PWA transfers, and sync status reports active stages and the last successful completion
- Google Contacts recovers from expired synchronization tokens
- Compact headers, reader controls, and phone landscape layouts keep actions accessible
- Demo Libraries restore sample thumbnails, maps, and grouped stories

### Downloads

**macOS:** `.dmg` (Apple Silicon or Intel, signed + notarized)  
**Windows:** `.exe` (NSIS installer)  
**Linux:** `.AppImage`  

> macOS downloads are signed and notarized for normal Gatekeeper installation.
